issues.description: The None equivalence repeats a direction already implied by the Some contract.
issues.rationale: Some postcondition implies existence of a matching table entry. Contrapositive gives no-match => not-Some => None. Thus right-to-left direction of None equivalence is redundant; retain None => no-match and all Some first-match facts.
